caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a mask that resembles a human face. The mask is primarily brown with darker and lighter shades creating the appearance of facial features, including pronounced eyebrows, cheekbones, a nose, and a mouth. The facial area has black lines accentuating the folds and divisions around the mouth and nose. The mask also has almond-shaped black eyes with white sclera. On the forehead and top of the mask, there is a beige band, above which sits an ornamental piece resembling a snake or serpent, curled and textured with yellowish and brown tones and detailed scales. The snake-like element forms a U-shape, starting above one temple, curving around the top of the head, and ending above the opposite temple. The background of the image is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery present. In the bottom right corner, “L. FLOGSTED” is written.
title: Figurehead "S.S. Robert Fulton"
